_note: SEC-07 upload fuzz corpus. Each entry is a payload an owner or visitor could send. `expect` is the status family the API must return: 'reject' = 4xx (a refusal the owner can act on), 'accept' = 2xx (ordinary file). The gate asserts that NO case produces 5xx: an unhandled parser exception is a bug even when the file is hostile.
